title: kith-peer: add attachments to build_peer_deliver_request and outbox_tick
description:
KITH-3yb.7 was closed as done but build_peer_deliver_request has no attachments parameter and outbox_tick does not load or pass message attachments.

Implement:
1. Add attachments: &[Attachment] parameter to build_peer_deliver_request; serialize as 'attachments' array in message JSON
2. In outbox_tick, after loading message, also load message.attachments via guard.messages().get() (which hydrates via AttachmentStore)
3. Pass attachments to build_peer_deliver_request
4. The PeerAttachment wire format: {blobId, filename, contentType, size, sha256}

Why: Without this, outgoing messages with attachments will be delivered with empty attachments; recipient will receive stripped messages.
notes: Part of Phase 2 peer delivery epic KITH-7w7
